title: Juicy Midnight Herbs Portuguese Stir-fry
description: This herbal and juicy dish features freshly chopped parsley and other aromatic herbs for a savory and refreshing twist on traditional Portuguese cuisine, suitable for midnight cravings without dairy.
instructions: Season pork belly with salt and pepper.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, cover with aluminum foil, and bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium heat, add olive oil and sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add bell peppers and cook for another 5 minutes.
Stir in chopped parsley, thyme leaves, rosemary sprigs, and pork belly slices. Continue to cook for an additional 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Serve hot as a snack or side dish.
